Every row below was **checked against the installed code**, not written as a question. `✗ found`
means the requirement, plan or task list is wrong on the current tree, with the evidence beside it.
`✓ verified` means it was measured and holds. `[ ]` means the implementation must answer it, and
the task that owns the answer is named.

| ID | Check | Dimension | Ref | Status |
|----|-------|-----------|-----|--------|
| CHK001 | Does the organization record hold the text the lockup's second line prints? **No.** CITe's `name` is `"Fab Lab CITe Bauru"` (`seed/index.ts`, `CITE_ORGANIZATION`) and the lockup's second line is `CITE BAURU`. `logotype={name}` renders **`FAB ◆ LAB / FAB LAB CITE BAURU`** — "Fab Lab" twice. D3's premise that the lab's name is already data is false: the lockup needs a **short name** the schema does not have, which means a field, a migration, and a wizard step (see CHK016) | [feasibility] | FR-014, D3, T018 | ✗ found |
| CHK002 | Does the "storage prefix" FR-005 previews exist? **No.** The S3 adapter is configured `collections: { [slug]: true }` with no prefix, and `plugin-cloud-storage`'s `getFileKey` returns `path.posix.join('', filename)` — **every organization's uploads share the bucket root**. `generateObjectKey`, the `org/<slug>/…` constructor T025 would build the preview from, has **no production caller**, asserted by `tests/checklists-adjudicated.test.ts` (CHK035). The wizard would preview a prefix nothing writes to — the exact "preview right while the system is wrong" D2 warns against | [consistency] | FR-005, D2, T025 | ✗ found |
| CHK003 | Can a live upload land under the quarantine prefix? **No** — quarantine keys come only from `generateObjectKey`, which has no production caller (CHK002). CLR-006's "exclude quarantine" addresses **zero rows**, and SC-015c can only be satisfied by a fixture the product never produces. Drop the exclusion and SC-015c, or state it is forward-looking for a presign path that does not exist | [consistency] | FR-029, CLR-006, SC-015c, T006 | ✗ found |
| CHK004 | Does the delta cover an **update that replaces the file**? No. T006 applies `+bytesOf` on create and `−bytesOf` on delete. The admin's *replace file* changes the bytes and regenerates derivatives on an existing document — `refuseOffPolicyUpload` itself distinguishes metadata-only edits from edits carrying a file. Uncovered, that is a permanent drift. Needs `−bytesOf(previousDoc) +bytesOf(doc)` on an update carrying a file | [completeness] | FR-030, D6b, T006 | ✗ found |
| CHK005 | Is *"the gate is the backstop"* true in production? **No.** The reconciliation gate is a CI test against a test database. After T007's one-time backfill, nothing recomputes production. A lost update from `applyDelta`'s read-modify-write window is **permanent there**. D6b names the failure direction correctly (errs toward admitting); its backstop claim holds only in CI. State the accepted production drift, or make the recompute runnable on demand — which is 008's territory | [consistency] | FR-028, D6b | ✗ found |
| CHK006 | Is a 404 the right expectation for an **anonymous** visitor to the wizard? **No.** `Users` declares no `access.admin`, and Payload redirects every unauthenticated `/admin/*` request to `/admin/login` before any view renders. Non-disclosure still holds, since every admin path redirects alike, but SC-005 and T029 expect a 404 and would fail — or be bent to pass. Amend both: anonymous gets the redirect any `/admin/*` path gets; maker and org admin get the view's `notFound()` | [testability] | FR-009, SC-005, T029 | ✗ found |
| CHK007 | Do the bytes reach S3 **after** the refusal point? **Yes.** `plugin-cloud-storage` uploads in its own `afterChange`, appended after the collection's hooks (`...existingCollection.hooks?.afterChange`), so a refusal in `beforeValidate`/`beforeChange` throws before any upload. T005 must **pin this ordering** too: a plugin upgrade moving the upload earlier would store bytes before the refusal | [feasibility] | FR-022, D5, T005 | ✓ verified |
| CHK008 | If the S3 upload fails after T006's delta has been applied in an earlier `afterChange`, is the delta rolled back? The delta runs **before** the plugin's upload hook. T006 must test: a failing upload leaves `storageUsedMb` unchanged | [completeness] | FR-028, T006 | [ ] |
| CHK009 | Are the units one thing everywhere? `limits.ts` defines `MEGABYTE = 1024 * 1024`, so 20480 "MB" is 20 GiB. The columns are `numeric`, so a 100 KB photo does not round to zero. The refusal message must print the same binary unit the quota is stored in | [clarity] | FR-021, FR-023, CLR-004 | ✓ verified (message open) |
| CHK010 | Is FR-006's reason for permanence true? `Organizations.ts` says a slug rename *"orphans every uploaded file"* because storage keys derive from it. By CHK002 that is **false for storage**. It is still true for host resolution, where step 1 matches the slug against the first host label. The wizard's copy must give the true reason | [consistency] | FR-006 | ✗ found |

The LGPD constraint *"deletion … purges … the storage prefix"* depends on a prefix that does not exist. That is out of this feature's scope, but it must be recorded | [consistency] | FR-035, T014 | ✗ found |
